reason: Provides inline, fullscreen previews for produced Markdown, image, code, and text files in the DeepSeek Harness conversation interface, with optional copy and system-app actions.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中直接预览生成的 Markdown、图片、代码和文本文件，并支持全屏查看、复制内容及使用系统应用打开。
summaries.en: Preview produced Markdown, image, code, and text files directly in DeepSeek Harness conversations with fullscreen viewing, content copying, and system-app opening.

capabilities: Reads produced files through a host RPC channel
Renders Markdown, images, code, and plain text previews
Opens selected files through the system application action
